title: Bone Tree
body:
Description

The Bone Tree was a limited tree released in the Halloween 2023 update, only spawning when a Halloween Meteor crashes. After the 1.60.0 update, the tree was readded permanently.

The Bone Tree surrounded a central Hallow Tree in groups of 4 or 5 when it spawned. It now spawns in the caves of the Oke Desert on Ferwater Island.

Trivia

  • This tree, along with the Hallow Tree and the Tree, was one of the only trees to have square shaped logs before it was changed.
  • This was the only tree that had leaves with player collisions.
  • Despite its similarities with the Hallow Tree, the Bone Tree is much easier to fell, requiring roughly 3-5 hits with the Refined Axe and 2 hits with the Emberbane.
  • When hit by a spore from the Mysterious Mushroom, it turns "Corrupted".
